en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5404 - Al-Mualla ibn Muhammad Al-Basri narrated from Jafar ibn Sulayman from Abdullah ibn Al-Hakam from his father from Said ibn Jubayr from Ibn Abbas, who said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:

"Indeed, Ali (as) is my successor and caliph, and his wife (Sayyida) Fatimah (as), my daughter, is the leader of the women of the worlds.
Al-Hasan (as) and Al-Hussain (as) are the leaders of the youth of Paradise, and they are my sons.
Whoever befriends Them (as) has befriended me (sw),
Whoever opposes Them (as) has opposed me (sw).
Whoever fights against Them (as) has fought against me (sw),
Whoever distances himself from Them (as) has distanced himself from me (sw),
And whoever honors Them (as) has honored me (sw).
May Allah (swt) maintain ties with those who maintain ties with Them (as) and sever ties with those who sever ties with them (as).
May Allah (swt) support those who aid Them (as) and forsake those who forsake them (as).

O' Allah (swt)! Just as every prophet and messenger had their own household and entrusted ones; Ali (as), (Sayyida) Fatimah (as), Al-Hasan (as), and Al-Hussain (as) are my household and my entrusted ones. So remove impurity from Them (as) and purify Them (as) completely."
